def_en: 1) to be or become weak, be or become sick, be or become diseased, be or become grieved, be or become sorry
1b1) to be or become weak, feel weak
1d) (Pual) to be made weak, become weak
1f3) to show signs of sickness, become sick
kjv: beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, [idiom] pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit ([idiom] supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.
expl: properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat
